verdict.rationale: Opting out of tracking is a fair question for a product analytics tool, but the evidence pack documents no opt-out or stop-tracking control. The privacy features it does show are adjacent: per-element exclusion via heap-ignore, global disableTextCapture redaction, PII masking, and a user-deletion API. None of these lets a user opt out of telemetry or usage tracking, so they earn no credit for this story.
